en-US.description: Upload one or more original model images and swap them to a new target model while keeping the styling, outfit, and scene consistent.
en-US.empty.baseModelImages: Upload at least 1 original model image first
en-US.empty.targetModel: Upload a target model image or choose a preset AI model first
en-US.error.noModels: No AI model is currently available
en-US.error.noSize: The current model does not provide a usable size preset
en-US.error.referenceLimit: The reference image limit for the current model has been reached
en-US.error.references: The uploaded images do not contain usable reference identifiers
en-US.handFootRepair.help: Used to improve hand and foot details after model swapping, reducing deformation, mismatched joints, or unnatural limb details.
en-US.label: AI Model Swap
en-US.preset.none.desc: Use only the uploaded target model image, or leave blank until you choose one.
en-US.preset.asianYoungFemale.desc: A young Asian female model with light skin tone and a clean commercial beauty look.
en-US.preset.blackYoungFemale.desc: A young Black female model with dark skin tone and a premium editorial presence.
en-US.preset.whiteMatureFemale.desc: A mature white female model with elegant high-end commercial styling.
en-US.preset.asianMatureMale.desc: A mature Asian male model with polished luxury campaign presence.
en-US.preset.blackMatureMale.desc: A mature Black male model with strong facial structure and premium fashion presence.
en-US.preset.whiteYoungMale.desc: A young white male model with bright skin tone and contemporary fashion styling.
en-US.upload.baseModelImages.help: Only single-person model images are supported. Avoid group photos, face occlusion, extreme looking down/up, or images where the body is heavily blocked.
en-US.upload.targetModelImage.help: Optional. Use this image to provide the new model's face, skin tone, hairstyle, and identity traits. Clothing and scene will not be copied from it.

zh-CN.button.generate: 生成 AI 换模特图
zh-CN.description: 上传一张或多张原模特图，并替换为新的目标模特，同时尽量保持服饰、场景与拍摄语言一致。
zh-CN.empty.baseModelImages: 请先上传至少 1 张原模特图
zh-CN.empty.targetModel: 请先上传目标模特图或选择一个预设 AI 模特
zh-CN.error.noModels: 暂无可用 AI 模型
zh-CN.error.noSize: 当前模型缺少可用尺寸配置
zh-CN.error.referenceLimit: 参考图数量已达当前模型上限
zh-CN.error.references: 图片缺少可用于生成的资源标识
zh-CN.handFootRepair.help: “手脚自动修复”用于优化换模特后手脚部位的细节，减少变形、错位或肢体不自然的问题。
zh-CN.label: AI换模特
zh-CN.preset.none.desc: 只使用上传的目标模特图，或先留空稍后再选。
zh-CN.preset.asianYoungFemale.desc: 偏年轻的亚洲女性模特，肤色偏浅，适合干净明亮的商业人像。
zh-CN.preset.blackYoungFemale.desc: 偏年轻的黑人女性模特，肤色较深，适合高级感编辑风格。
zh-CN.preset.whiteMatureFemale.desc: 成熟女性白人模特，气质优雅，适合高端商业形象。
zh-CN.preset.asianMatureMale.desc: 成熟亚洲男性模特，适合稳重高级的商业拍摄风格。
zh-CN.preset.blackMatureMale.desc: 成熟黑人男性模特，面部结构鲜明，适合高级时尚视觉。
zh-CN.preset.whiteYoungMale.desc: 偏年轻的白人男性模特，适合现代感商业服饰展示。
zh-CN.toast.success: AI 换模特图生成成功！
zh-CN.upload.baseModelImages.help: 仅支持单人模特图，不支持多人图、明显面部遮挡、明显低头/抬头或身体大面积被遮挡的图片。
zh-CN.upload.targetModelImage.help: 可选。用于提供新的模特脸部、肤色、发型和身份特征，不会复制该图里的服饰与场景。
